dek: Set for 18 October 2026 at AEON Mall AU2 Setiawangsa in Kuala Lumpur, this single-distance half marathon offers a focused 21K with registration open. A KL suburb race for local runners.
verdict: The Setiawangsa Half Marathon is a focused, single-distance 21.1K in the Setiawangsa suburb of Kuala Lumpur, anchored at AEON Mall AU2. The mall-anchored venue provides practical race-day logistics — parking, pre-race shelter, post-race food — and the single-distance format keeps the event streamlined. Registration is open. A straightforward, low-friction KL half marathon for local runners.
